      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string, metadata?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e): DetectedConnection {\n    const reasons: string[] = [];\n    let confidence = 0;\n\n    // Check for Xata URL patterns\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      reasons.push('URL contains .xata.sh domain');\n      confidence += 0.8;\n\n      // Determine if it's HTTP API or Postgres wire\n      if (connectionString.startsWith('https://') || connectionString.startsWith('http://')) {\n        reasons.push('HTTPS URL indicates Xata Lite HTTP API');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_lite_http',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      } else if (connectionString.startsWith('postgres://') || connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n        reasons.push('PostgreSQL connection string with Xata domain indicates wire protocol support');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence, reasons };\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Xata Database Operations Guide\n\nThis guide provides a comprehensive reference for implementing CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on Xata database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.\n\n## Database Schema Overview\n\nRefer to @xata-schema.mdc\n\nThe Xata database contains the following tables:\n\n### Core Tables\n| Table | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| &#96;topics&#96; | Information about UFO/UAP-related topics |\n| &#96;personnel&#96; | People involved in UFO/UAP cases (witnesses, experts, officials) |\n| &#96;events&#96; | UFO/UAP incidents and historical events |\n| &#96;organizations&#96; | Groups, agencies, and organizations |\n| &#96;sightings&#96; | UFO/UAP sighting reports |\n| &#96;testimonies&#96; | Witness statements and claims |\n| &#96;documents&#96; | Documentation, reports, and files |\n| &#96;artifacts&#96; | Physical evidence and artifacts |\n| &#96;locations&#96; | Physical locations related to UFO/UAP incidents |\n| &#96;key-figures&#96; | Key individuals in UFO/UAP research and history |\n| &#96;theories&#96; | Explanatory theories about UFO/UAP phenomena |\n| &#96;tags&#96; | Tags for categorizing content |\n| &#96;users&#96; | System users |\n| &#96;user-notes&#96; | User-created notes and theories |\n| &#96;mindmaps&#96; | User-created mind maps for connecting information |\n\n### Relationship Tables\n| Table | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| &#96;event-subject-matter-experts&#96; | Connects events to subject matter experts |\n| &#96;event-topic-subject-matter-experts&#96; | Links events, topics, and subject matter experts |\n| &#96;organization-members&#96; | Connects organizations to their members |\n| &#96;topic-subject-matter-experts&#96; | Links topics to subject matter experts |\n| &#96;topics-testimonies&#96; | Connects topics to testimonies |\n| &#96;summary-files&#96; | Links summaries to documents |\n\n### User Relationship Tables\n| Table | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| &#96;user-saved-documents&#96; | Documents saved by users |\n| &#96;user-saved-events&#96; | Events saved by users |\n| &#96;user-saved-key-figure&#96; | Key figures saved by users |\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class XataLiteAdapter extends BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Xata-specific methods using SDK\n  async getRecords(tableName: string, options: {\n    page?: { size?: number; offset?: number };\n    filter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e;\n    sort?: { column: string; direction: \"asc\" | \"desc\" }[];\n    columns?: string[];\n  } = {}): Promise\u003c{ records: XataRecord[]; meta: any }\u003e {\n    const table = this.xataClient.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];\n    \n    // Build filter chain (correct Xata SDK pattern)\n    let query = table.filter(options.filter || {});\n    \n    // Add column selection if specified\n    if (options.columns \u0026\u0026 options.columns.length \u003e 0) {\n      query = query.select(options.columns as any);\n    }\n    \n    // Add sorting if specified\n    if (options.sort \u0026\u0026 options.sort.length \u003e 0) {\n      for (const { column, direction } of options.sort) {\n        query = query.sort(column as any, direction);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Get results with pagination\n    if (options.page) {\n      const result = await query.getPaginated({\n        pagination: { \n          size: options.page.size || 20,\n          offset: options.page.offset || 0 \n        }\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        records: result.records as XataRecord[],\n        meta: { hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage() }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    // Get results without pagination\n    const records = await query.getMany();\n    return {\n      records: records as XataRecord[],\n      meta: {}\n    };\n  }",

+ /**
+  * Utilities for Non Postgres Wire Enabled Xata Instances
+  * 
+  * This module provides enhanced utilities for Xata instances that do NOT have
+  * Postgres Wire Protocol enabled (HTTP API only).
+  */
+ 
+ import { wirelessXataClient } from '../../legacy/xata/wireless';
+ import { tables, type DatabaseSchema } from '../../legacy/xata/xata';
+ 
+ export interface XataConnection {
+   endpoint: string;
+   apiKey: string;
+   database: string;
+   branch: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface XataQueryOptions {
+   page?: { size?: number; offset?: number };
+   filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+   sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+   columns?: string[];
+ }
+ 
+ export interface XataSearchOptions {
+   target?: string[];
+   prefix?: 'phrase' | 'disabled';
+   fuzziness?: number;
+   highlight?: boolean;
+   size?: number;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface XataVectorSearchOptions {
+   size?: number;
+   filter?: any;
+   similarityFunction?: 'cosineSimilarity' | 'dotProduct';
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Parse Xata HTTP endpoint to extract connection details
+  */
+ export function parseXataEndpoint(endpoint: string): Partial&lt;XataConnection&gt; {
+   if (!endpoint.startsWith('http://') &amp;&amp; !endpoint.startsWith('https://')) {
+     throw new Error('Xata endpoint must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL');
+   }
+ 
+   const url = new URL(endpoint);
+   const pathParts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(part =&gt; part.length &gt; 0);
+   
+   if (pathParts.length &lt; 2 || pathParts[0] !== 'db') {
+     throw new Error('Invalid Xata endpoint format. Expected: https://workspace.region.xata.sh/db/database-name');
+   }
+ 
+   return {
+     endpoint,
+     database: pathParts[1],
+     branch: 'main' // Default branch
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Validate Xata Non Wire connection configuration
+  */
+ export function validateXataNonWireConfig(config: Partial&lt;XataConnection&gt;): string[] {
+   const errors: string[] = [];
+ 
+   if (!config.endpoint) {
+     errors.push('Endpoint URL is required');
+   } else if (!config.endpoint.includes('.xata.sh')) {
+     errors.push('Endpoint must be a valid Xata domain (.xata.sh)');
+   }
+ 
+   if (!config.apiKey) {
+     errors.push('API key is required for Xata HTTP API');
+   }
+ 
+   if (!config.database) {
+     errors.push('Database name is required');
+   }
+ 
+   return errors;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Test Xata Non Wire connection
+  */
+ export async function testXataNonWireConnection(config: XataConnection): Promise&lt;{
+   success: boolean;
+   error?: string;
+   details?: any;
+ }&gt; {
+   try {
+     // Test basic connection by getting first record from events table
+     const result = await wirelessXataClient.db.events.getFirst();
+     
+     return {
+       success: true,
+       details: {
+         connected: true,
+         testQuery: 'events.getFirst()',
+         hasData: !!result
+       }
+     };
+   } catch (error) {
+     return {
+       success: false,
+       error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown connection error',
+       details: {
+         connected: false,
+         endpoint: config.endpoint,
+         database: config.database
+       }
+     };
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get table list from Xata Non Wire instance
+  */
+ export async function getXataNonWireTables(): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{
+   name: string;
+   type: 'table';
+   recordCount?: number;
+ }&gt;&gt; {
+   return tables.map(table =&gt; ({
+     name: table.name,
+     type: 'table' as const
+   }));
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Enhanced CRUD operations for Non Wire Xata
+  */
+ export class XataNonWireCRUD {
+   private client = wirelessXataClient;
+ 
+   /**
+    * Get records with advanced filtering and pagination
+    */
+   async getRecords(tableName: string, options: XataQueryOptions = {}) {
+     const table = this.client.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];
+     
+     if (!table) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;Table '${tableName}' not found in database schema&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     // Build filter chain
+     let query = table.filter(options.filter || {});
+     
+     // Add column selection
+     if (options.columns &amp;&amp; options.columns.length &gt; 0) {
+       query = query.select(options.columns as any);
+     }
+     
+     // Add sorting
+     if (options.sort &amp;&amp; options.sort.length &gt; 0) {
+       for (const { column, direction } of options.sort) {
+         query = query.sort(column as any, direction);
+       }
+     }
+     
+     // Handle pagination
+     if (options.page) {
+       const result = await query.getPaginated({
+         pagination: { 
+           size: options.page.size || 20,
+           offset: options.page.offset || 0 
+         }
+       });
+       
+       return {
+         records: result.records,
+         meta: { 
+           hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage(),
+           pagination: options.page
+         }
+       };
+     }
+     
+     // Get all records
+     const records = await query.getMany();
+     return {
+       records,
+       meta: { hasNextPage: false }
+     };
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Create new record
+    */
+   async createRecord(tableName: string, data: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) {
+     const table = this.client.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];
+     
+     if (!table) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;Table '${tableName}' not found in database schema&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     return await table.create(data);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Update existing record
+    */
+   async updateRecord(tableName: string, recordId: string, updates: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) {
+     const table = this.client.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];
+     
+     if (!table) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;Table '${tableName}' not found in database schema&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     return await table.update(recordId, updates);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Delete record
+    */
+   async deleteRecord(tableName: string, recordId: string) {
+     const table = this.client.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];
+     
+     if (!table) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;Table '${tableName}' not found in database schema&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     return await table.delete(recordId);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Advanced search across records
+    */
+   async searchRecords(tableName: string, searchQuery: string, options: XataSearchOptions = {}) {
+     const table = this.client.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];
+     
+     if (!table) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;Table '${tableName}' not found in database schema&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     // Use Xata's search functionality
+     return await this.client.search.all(searchQuery, {
+       tables: [{ table: tableName }],
+       fuzziness: options.fuzziness || 1,
+       prefix: options.prefix || 'phrase'
+     });
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Vector similarity search (if vector columns exist)
+    */
+   async vectorSearch(tableName: string, column: string, vector: number[], options: XataVectorSearchOptions = {}) {
+     const table = this.client.db[tableName as keyof DatabaseSchema];
+     
+     if (!table) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;Table '${tableName}' not found in database schema&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     // Xata vector search
+     return await table.vectorSearch(column, vector, {
+       size: options.size || 10,
+       filter: options.filter,
+       similarityFunction: options.similarityFunction || 'cosineSimilarity'
+     });
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * UFO/UAP specific queries for Non Wire Xata
+  */
+ export class XataUFOQueries {
+   private crud = new XataNonWireCRUD();
+ 
+   async getUFOEventsByLocation(limit = 20) {
+     return await this.crud.getRecords('events', {
+       filter: {
+         $any: [
+           { category: { $contains: "UFO" } },
+           { category: { $contains: "UAP" } },
+           { description: { $contains: "sighting" } }
+         ]
+       },
+       sort: [{ column: 'date', direction: 'desc' }],
+       page: { size: limit }
+     });
+   }
+ 
+   async getKeyFiguresByCredibility(limit = 10) {
+     return await this.crud.getRecords('key-figures', {
+       sort: [{ column: 'credibility', direction: 'desc' }],
+       page: { size: limit }
+     });
+   }
+ 
+   async searchUFODocuments(query: string) {
+     return await this.crud.searchRecords('documents', &#96;UFO ${query}&#96;);
+   }
+ 
+   async getRecentTestimonies(days = 30) {
+     const cutoffDate = new Date();
+     cutoffDate.setDate(cutoffDate.getDate() - days);
+     
+     return await this.crud.getRecords('testimonies', {
+       filter: {
+         created_at: { $ge: cutoffDate.toISOString() }
+       },
+       sort: [{ column: 'created_at', direction: 'desc' }]
+     });
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Export singleton instances
+ export const xataNonWireCRUD = new XataNonWireCRUD();
+ export const xataUFOQueries = new XataUFOQueries();

        "originalContents": "\n\n  async getDatabaseStats(): Promise\u003cDatabaseStats\u003e {\n    const baseStats = await super.getDatabaseStats();\n    \n    // Add Xata-specific enhancements\n    try {\n      // Check for Xata-specific extensions or features\n      const xataExtensions = await this.executeQuery(&#96;\n        SELECT extname as name, extversion as version \n        FROM pg_extension \n        WHERE extname LIKE '%xata%' OR extname LIKE '%vector%'\n      &#96;);\n\n      const xataFunctions = await this.executeQuery(&#96;\n        SELECT routine_name as name \n        FROM information_schema.routines \n        WHERE routine_schema = 'public' \n        AND (routine_name LIKE '%xata%' OR routine_name LIKE '%vector%')\n      &#96;);\n\n      return {\n        ...baseStats,\n        version: &#96;${baseStats.version} (Xata Postgres Wire Enabled)&#96;,\n        metadata: {\n          xataExtensions: xataExtensions.rows,\n          xataFunctions: xataFunctions.rows,\n          isXataPostgres: true\n        }\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // If Xata-specific queries fail, return base stats\n      return {\n        ...baseStats,\n        version: &#96;${baseStats.version} (Xata Postgres Wire Enabled)&#96;\n      };\n    }\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class XataLiteAdapter extends BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n  private baseUrl: string;\n  private apiKey: string;\n  private branch: string;\n  \n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n    this.parseXataConfig(config);\n  }\n  \n  async executeQuery(query: string, params: any[] = []): Promise\u003cQueryResult\u003e {\n    // Xata Lite doesn't support arbitrary SQL\n    throw new Error('Raw SQL queries not supported in Xata Lite');\n  }\n  \n  // Xata-specific methods\n  async getRecords(tableName: string, options: XataQueryOptions): Promise\u003cXataRecordsResult\u003e {\n    const response = await this.makeRequest('POST', &#96;/tables/${tableName}/query&#96;, options);\n    return await response.json();\n  }\n  \n  async searchRecords(tableName: string, query: string, options: XataSearchOptions): Promise\u003cXataSearchResult\u003e {\n    const response = await this.makeRequest('POST', &#96;/tables/${tableName}/search&#96;, {\n      query,\n      ...options\n    });\n    return await response.json();\n  }\n}\n\n// Postgres Wire Adapter\nclass XataPostgresAdapter extends PostgreSQLAdapter {\n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n  }\n  \n  async executeQuery(query: string, params: any[] = []): Promise\u003cQueryResult\u003e {\n    // Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n    return await super.executeQuery(query, params);\n  }\n  \n  // Xata-enhanced methods\n  async getXataMetadata(): Promise\u003cXataMetadata\u003e {\n    const result = await this.executeQuery(&#96;\n      SELECT \n        table_name,\n        column_name,\n        data_type\n      FROM information_schema.columns \n      WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n      ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position\n    &#96;);\n    \n    return this.parseXataMetadata(result.rows);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Adapter Factory Pattern\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// From: apps/dbagent/src/lib/adapters/base.ts\n",

        "originalContents": "class XataLiteAdapter extends BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n  private baseUrl: string;\n  private apiKey: string;\n  private branch: string;\n  \n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n    this.parseXataConfig(config);\n  }\n  \n  async executeQuery(query: string, params: any[] = []): Promise\u003cQueryResult\u003e {\n    // Xata Lite doesn't support arbitrary SQL\n    throw new Error('Raw SQL queries not supported in Xata Lite');\n  }\n  \n  // Xata-specific methods\n  async getRecords(tableName: string, options: XataQueryOptions): Promise\u003cXataRecordsResult\u003e {\n    const response = await this.makeRequest('POST', &#96;/tables/${tableName}/query&#96;, options);\n    return await response.json();\n  }\n  \n  async searchRecords(tableName: string, query: string, options: XataSearchOptions): Promise\u003cXataSearchResult\u003e {\n    const response = await this.makeRequest('POST', &#96;/tables/${tableName}/search&#96;, {\n      query,\n      ...options\n    });\n    return await response.json();\n  }\n}\n\n// Postgres Wire Adapter\nclass XataPostgresAdapter extends PostgreSQLAdapter {\n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n  }\n  \n  async executeQuery(query: string, params: any[] = []): Promise\u003cQueryResult\u003e {\n    // Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n    return await super.executeQuery(query, params);\n  }\n  \n  // Xata-enhanced methods\n  async getXataMetadata(): Promise\u003cXataMetadata\u003e {\n    const result = await this.executeQuery(&#96;\n      SELECT \n        table_name,\n        column_name,\n        data_type\n      FROM information_schema.columns \n      WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n      ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position\n    &#96;);\n    \n    return this.parseXataMetadata(result.rows);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Adapter Factory Pattern\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// From: apps/dbagent/src/lib/adapters/base.ts\n",

        "contents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string, metadata?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e): DetectedConnection {\n    const reasons: string[] = [];\n    let confidence = 0;\n\n    // Check for Xata URL patterns\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      reasons.push('URL contains .xata.sh domain');\n      confidence += 0.8;\n\n      // Determine if it's HTTP API or Postgres wire\n      if (connectionString.startsWith('https://') || connectionString.startsWith('http://')) {\n        reasons.push('HTTPS URL indicates Xata Lite HTTP API');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_lite_http',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      } else if (connectionString.startsWith('postgres://') || connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n        reasons.push('PostgreSQL connection string with Xata domain indicates wire protocol support');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence, reasons };\n  }",

        "contents": "# Xata SQL Methods Documentation\n\n## Table of Contents\n1. [Overview](#overview)\n2. [Connection Methods](#connection-methods)\n3. [Core SQL Methods](#core-sql-methods)\n4. [CRUD Operations](#crud-operations)\n5. [Advanced Features](#advanced-features)\n6. [Performance \u0026 Optimization](#performance--optimization)\n7. [Integration Patterns](#integration-patterns)\n8. [Error Handling](#error-handling)\n9. [Best Practices](#best-practices)\n10. [Examples \u0026 Use Cases](#examples--use-cases)\n\n## Overview\n\nXata provides SQL capabilities through two distinct approaches:\n\n### 1. Xata Lite (HTTP API)\n- **Protocol**: HTTP/HTTPS REST API\n- **SQL Support**: Limited subset of SQL commands\n- **Use Case**: Simple queries, built-in search features\n- **Limitations**: No complex joins, limited transaction support\n\n### 2. Xata Postgres Wire Protocol\n- **Protocol**: PostgreSQL wire protocol\n- **SQL Support**: Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n- **Use Case**: Complex queries, advanced analytics, migrations\n- **Benefits**: Complete SQL feature set, performance monitoring\n\n## Connection Methods\n\n### HTTP API Connection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { XataApiClient } from '@xata.io/client';\n\nconst xata = new XataApiClient({\n  apiKey: 'xau_your_api_key_here',\n  databaseURL: 'https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh',\n  branch: 'main'\n});\n\n// Execute SQL via HTTP\nconst result = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE email = ${email}&#96;;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Postgres Wire Connection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Client } from 'pg';\n\nconst client = new Client({\n  connectionString: 'postgresql://user:password@workspace.region.sql.xata.sh/database:branch?sslmode=require'\n});\n\nawait client.connect();\nconst result = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1', [email]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core SQL Methods\n\n### 1. Query Execution\n\n#### HTTP API Method\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface XataHttpSqlOptions {\n  consistency?: 'strong' | 'eventual';\n  timeout?: number;\n}\n\n// Template literal syntax (recommended)\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n  detect(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    // Detect Xata connections\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      return this.detectXata(connectionString, apiKey);\n    }\n    \n    // Detect other database types\n    return this.detectOtherDatabases(connectionString);\n  }\n  \n  private detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    if (connectionString.startsWith('https://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_lite_http',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['HTTPS URL with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          requiresApiKey: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    if (connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['PostgreSQL connection string with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          supportsSql: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence: 0, reasons: [] };\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Connection Pool Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Connection pool for Postgres Wire\n",

        ],
        "originalContents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n  detect(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    // Detect Xata connections\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      return this.detectXata(connectionString, apiKey);\n    }\n    \n    // Detect other database types\n    return this.detectOtherDatabases(connectionString);\n  }\n  \n  private detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    if (connectionString.startsWith('https://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_lite_http',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['HTTPS URL with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          requiresApiKey: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    if (connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['PostgreSQL connection string with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          supportsSql: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence: 0, reasons: [] };\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Connection Pool Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Connection pool for Postgres Wire\n",

        "originalContents": "const result = await xata.sql&#96;\n  UPDATE \"users\"\n  SET last_login = ${new Date()}\n  WHERE email = ${email} AND active = true\n  RETURNING id, name, last_login\n&#96;;\n\n// Postgres Wire with transaction\nawait client.query('BEGIN');\ntry {\n  const result = await client.query(\n    'UPDATE users SET last_login = $1 WHERE email = $2 AND active = true RETURNING *',\n    [new Date(), email]\n  );\n  \n  if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error('User not found or inactive');\n  }\n  \n  await client.query('COMMIT');\n} catch (error) {\n  await client.query('ROLLBACK');\n  throw error;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### DELETE Operations\n\n#### Safe Deletion with Conditions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API\nconst deletedUser = await xata.sql&#96;\n  DELETE FROM \"users\"\n  WHERE id = ${userId} AND active = false\n  RETURNING id, name\n&#96;;\n\n// Postgres Wire\nconst deletedUser = await client.query(\n  'DELETE FROM users WHERE id = $1 AND active = false RETURNING id, name',\n  [userId]\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Advanced Features\n\n### Vector Search\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API (if vector search is enabled)\nconst similarDocuments = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT *, vector_similarity(embedding, ${queryEmbedding}) as similarity\n  FROM \"documents\"\n  ORDER BY similarity DESC\n  LIMIT LIMIT 10\n&#96;, [queryEmbedding]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Full-Text Search\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API\nconst searchResults = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"documents\"\n  WHERE to_tsvector('english', content) @@ to_tsquery('english', ${searchTerm})\n&#96;;\n\n// Postgres Wire with advanced text search\nconst searchResults = await client.query(&#96;\n  SELECT \n    *,\n    ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', content), to_tsquery('english', $1)) as rank\n  FROM documents\n  WHERE to_tsvector('english', content) @@ to_tsquery('english', $1)\n  ORDER BY rank DESC\n&#96;, \u0026 Optimization\n\n### Query Optimization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Use EXPLAIN to analyze query performance (Postgres Wire only)\nconst explainResult = await client.query(&#96;\n  EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) \n  SELECT * FROM users u\n  JOIN profiles p ON u.id = p.user_id\n  WHERE u.created_at \u003e $1\n&#96;, [startDate]);\n\nconsole.log('Query plan:', event_details\n  FROM events\n  WHERE metadata-\u003e\u003e'type' = $1\n  AND metadata-\u003e'location'-\u003e\u003e'country' = $2\n&#96;, [eventType, country]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Performance \u0026 Optimization\n\n### Query Optimization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Use EXPLAIN to analyze query performance (Postgres Wire only)\nconst explainResult = await client.query(&#96;\n  EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) \n  SELECT * FROM users u\n  JOIN profiles p ON u.id = p.user_id\n  WHERE u.created_at \u003e $1\n&#96;, [startDate]);\n\nconsole.log('Query plan:', explainResult.rows);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pagination Best Practices\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Cursor-based pagination (efficient for large datasets)\nconst pageSize = 20;\nconst cursor = 'last_record_id';\n\n// HTTP API\nconst nextPage = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"users\"\n  WHERE id \u003e ${cursor}\n  ORDER BY id ASC\n  LIMIT ${pageSize}\n&#96;;\n\n// Postgres Wire\nconst nextPage = await client.query(\n  'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id \u003e $1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2',\n  [cursor, pageSize]\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Connection Pooling\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Pool } from 'pg';\n\n// Create connection pool for Postgres Wire\nconst pool = new Pool({\n  connectionString: 'postgresql://user:password@host/database',\n  max: 20,\n  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,\n  connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000,\n});\n\n// Use pool for queries\nconst result = await pool.query(\n  'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1',\n  [email]\n);\n\n// Graceful shutdown\nprocess.on('SIGINT', () =\u003e {\n  pool.end(() =\u003e {\n    console.log('Pool has ended');\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n##         "contents": "### 3. Resource Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Always clean up connections\nclass DatabaseService {\n  private client: Client;\n  \n  constructor(connectionString: string) {\n    this.client = new Client({ connectionString });\n  }\n  \n  async connect() {\n    await this.client.connect();\n  }\n  \n  async disconnect() {\n    await this.client.end();\n  }\n  \n  async query(text: string, params?: any[]) {\n    try {\n      return await this.client.query(text, params);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Query failed:', { text, params, error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Migration Guide\n\n### From HTTP API to Postgres Wire\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Before (HTTP API)\nconst users = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE active = true&#96;;\n\n// After (Postgres Wire)\nconst users = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = true');\n\n// Key differences:\n// 1. No need to quote table names in Postgres Wire\n// 2. Different parameter syntax ($1, $2 vs template literals)\n// 3. Full PostgreSQL feature set available\n// 4. Better performance monitoring and optimization tools\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Adapter Migration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Detect and migrate connections\nimport { ConnectionDetector } from './lib/adapters/connection-detector';\n\nconst detector = new ConnectionDetector();\nconst detection = detector.detect(connectionString, apiKey);\n\nif (detection.type === 'xata_lite_http') {\n  console.log('Migrating from Xata Lite to Postgres Wire...');\n  // Migration logic here\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### Common Issues\n\n1. **Connection Timeouts**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Increase timeout for long-running queries\nconst result = await xata.sql({\n  statement: 'SELECT * FROM large_table',\n  timeout: 30000 // 30 seconds\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Memory Issues**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Use streaming for large result sets (Postgres Wire)\nconst query = new QueryStream('SELECT * FROM large_table');\n",

Parameter Binding\n\n#### HTTP API\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Safe parameter binding\nconst searchTerm = \"John Doe\";\nconst users = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"users\" \n  WHERE name ILIKE ${&#96;%${searchTerm}%&#96;}\n&#96;;\n\n// Multiple parameters\nconst result = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"events\" \n  WHERE date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}\n  AND location = ${location}\n&#96;;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Postgres Wire\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Positional parameters\nconst result = await client.query(\n  'SELECT * FROM users WHERE name ILIKE $1 AND age \u003e $2',\n  [&#96;%${searchTerm}%&#96;, minAge]\n);\n\n// Named parameters (using pg-format)\nimport format from 'pg-format';\nconst query = format(\n  'SELECT * FROM %I WHERE %I = %L',\n  tableName, columnName, value\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## CRUD Operations\n\n### SELECT Operations\n\n#### Basic Queries\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API\nconst allUsers = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\"&#96;;\nconst specificUser = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE id = ${userId}&#96;;\n\n// Postgres Wire\nconst allUsers = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users');\nconst specificUser = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Complex Queries with Joins\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API (limited join support)\n",

        "originalContents": "const users = await xata.sql\u003cUserRecord\u003e&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"users\" \n  WHERE created_at \u003e ${startDate}\n  ORDER BY created_at DESC\n  LIMIT 10\n&#96;;\n\n// Object syntax\nconst result = await xata.sql({\n  statement: 'SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE email = $1',\n  params: [email],\n  consistency: 'eventual'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Postgres Wire Method\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Standard pg client\nconst result = await client.query(\n  'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1',\n  [email]\n);\n\n// With prepared statements\nconst statement = {\n  name: 'get-user-by-email',\n  text: 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1'\n};\nconst result = await client.query(statement, [email]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Parameter Binding\n\n#### HTTP API\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Safe parameter binding\nconst searchTerm = \"John Doe\";\nconst users = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"users\" \n  WHERE name ILIKE ${&#96;%${searchTerm}%&#96;}\n&#96;;\n\n// Multiple parameters\nconst result = await xata.sql&#96;\n  SELECT * FROM \"events\" \n  WHERE date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}\n  AND location = ${location}\n&#96;;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Postgres Wire\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Positional parameters\nconst result = await client.query(\n  'SELECT * FROM users WHERE name ILIKE $1 AND age \u003e $2',\n  [&#96;%${searchTerm}%&#96;, minAge]\n);\n\n// Named parameters (using pg-format)\nimport format from 'pg-format';\nconst query = format(\n  'SELECT * FROM %I WHERE %I = %L',\n  tableName, columnName, value\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## CRUD Operations\n\n### SELECT Operations\n\n#### Basic Queries\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API\nconst allUsers = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\"&#96;;\nconst specificUser = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE id = ${userId}&#96;;\n\n// Postgres Wire\nconst allUsers = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users');\nconst specificUser = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Complex Queries with Joins\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// HTTP API (limited join support)\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class XataMCPTools {\n  constructor(private adapter: BaseDatabaseAdapter) {}\n  \n  @mcpTool('xata-query')\n  async executeQuery(params: {\n    query: string;\n    parameters?: any[];\n    consistency?: 'strong' | 'eventual';\n  }) {\n    if (this.adapter instanceof XataLiteAdapter) {\n      // HTTP API approach\n      return await this.adapter.sql({\n        statement: params.query,\n        params: params.parameters,\n        consistency: params.consistency\n      });\n    } else if (this.adapter instanceof XataPostgresAdapter) {\n      // Postgres wire approach\n      return await this.adapter.executeQuery(params.query, params.parameters);\n    }\n    \n    throw new Error('Unsupported adapter for SQL queries');\n  }\n  \n  @mcpTool('xata-search')\n  async searchContent(params: {\n    table: string;\n    query: string;\n    options?: SearchOptions;\n  }) {\n    if (this.adapter instanceof XataLiteAdapter) {\n      return await this.adapter.searchRecords(params.table, params.query, params.options);\n    }\n    \n    // Fallback to text search for Postgres\n    return await this.adapter.executeQuery(&#96;\n      SELECT * FROM ${params.table}\n      WHERE to_tsvector('english', content) @@ to_tsquery('english', $1)\n    &#96;, [params.query]);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Web UI Integration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Frontend integration with Xata adapters\n",

        "contents": "- **Xata Postgres Wire**: Full PostgreSQL compatibility with advanced features\n- **Auto-detection**: Automatic connection type detection and configuration\n\n### SQL Operations\n- **Basic CRUD**: Create, Read, Update, Delete operations\n- **Advanced Queries**: Joins, aggregations, window functions\n- **Search Capabilities**: Full-text search and vector similarity\n- **Performance**: Query optimization and connection pooling\n\n### Integration Patterns\n- **Adapter Pattern**: Abstraction layer for different connection types\n- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic adapter creation and management\n- **Repository Pattern**: Data access object implementation\n- **MCP Integration**: Model Context Protocol server tools\n\n## 📋 Implementation Checklist\n\n### Basic Setup\n- [ ] Review connection configuration examples\n- [ ] Understand adapter factory pattern\n- [ ] Set up connection detection\n- [ ] Configure error handling\n\n### Advanced Features\n- [ ] Implement vector search capabilities\n- [ ] Set up performance monitoring\n- [ ] Configure connection pooling\n- [ ] Add security validation\n\n### Integration\n- [ ] Connect with existing adapters\n- [ ] Integrate with MCP servers\n- [ ] Add to web UI components\n- [ ] Set up logging and monitoring\n\n## 🏗️ Project Structure Integration\n\n### Existing Codebase Files Referenced\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/dbagent/src/lib/adapters/\n├── base.ts                    #         "contents": "// https://github.com/xataio/agent/wiki/Create-custom-tools-via-a-local-MCP-server\n// MCP Server for Xata HTTP API (Wireless/Non-PostgreSQL)\n\nimport { Server } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js';\nimport { StdioServerTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js';\nimport {\n  CallToolRequestSchema,\n  ListResourcesRequestSchema,\n  ListToolsRequestSchema,\n  ReadResourceRequestSchema\n} from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js';\n\nconst server = new Server(\n  {\n    name: 'xata-http',\n    version: '0.1.0'\n  },\n  {\n    capabilities: {\n      resources: {},\n      tools: {}\n    }\n  }\n);\n\n// Configuration from environment variables\nconst XATA_API_KEY = process.env.XATA_API_KEY;\nconst XATA_DATABASE_URL = process.env.XATA_DATABASE_URL;\nconst XATA_BRANCH = process.env.XATA_BRANCH || 'main';\n\nif (!XATA_API_KEY) {\n  throw new Error('XATA_API_KEY environment variable is not set');\n}\n\nif (!XATA_DATABASE_URL) {\n  throw new Error('XATA_DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set (e.g., https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh/db/database-name)');\n}\n\n// Parse the database URL to extract components\nconst dbUrl = new URL(XATA_DATABASE_URL);\nconst baseUrl = &#96;${dbUrl.protocol}//${dbUrl.host}&#96;;\nconst pathParts = dbUrl.pathname.split('/');\nconst databaseName = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1];\n\n// Known table names (fallback if schema endpoint doesn't work)\nconst KNOWN_TABLES = [\n  'key-figures', 'events', 'organizations', 'documents', 'sightings',\n  'testimonies', 'topics', 'personnel', 'locations', 'sources'\n];",

        "originalContents": "// https://github.com/xataio/agent/wiki/Create-custom-tools-via-a-local-MCP-server\n// MCP Server for Xata HTTP API (Wireless/Non-PostgreSQL)\n\nimport { Server } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js';\nimport { StdioServerTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js';\nimport {\n  CallToolRequestSchema,\n  ListResourcesRequestSchema,\n  ListToolsRequestSchema,\n  ReadResourceRequestSchema\n} from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js';\n\nconst server = new Server(\n  {\n    name: 'xata-http',\n    version: '0.1.0'\n  },\n  {\n    capabilities: {\n      resources: {},\n      tools: {}\n    }\n  }\n);\n\n// Configuration from environment variables\nconst XATA_API_KEY = process.env.XATA_API_KEY;\nconst XATA_DATABASE_URL = process.env.XATA_DATABASE_URL;\nconst XATA_BRANCH = process.env.XATA_BRANCH || 'main';\n\nif (!XATA_API_KEY) {\n  throw new Error('XATA_API_KEY environment variable is not set');\n}\n\nif (!XATA_DATABASE_URL) {\n  throw new Error('XATA_DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set (e.g., https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh/db/database-name)');\n}\n\n// Parse the database URL to extract components\nconst dbUrl = new URL(XATA_DATABASE_URL);\nconst baseUrl = &#96;${dbUrl.protocol}//${dbUrl.host}&#96;;\nconst pathParts = dbUrl.pathname.split('/');\nconst databaseName = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1];\n\n// Known table names (fallback if schema endpoint doesn't work)\nconst KNOWN_TABLES = [\n  'key-figures', 'events', 'organizations', 'documents', 'sightings',\n  'testimonies', 'topics', 'personnel', 'locations', 'sources'\n];",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n\n/**\n * Quick Connection Test Script\n * Tests both Xata Lite and Xata Postgres connections\n */\n\nconst { Client } = require('pg');\n\n// Test configurations\nconst tests = [\n  {\n    name: 'Xata Lite (HTTP API)',\n    type: 'http',\n    config: {\n      url: 'https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial',\n      apiKey: 'xau_LKJxzxjzXasEUXxjmhCBACdTCvi5Ed2v1'\n    }\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Xata Postgres (Wire Protocol)',\n    type: 'postgres',\n    config: {\n      connectionString: 'postgresql://kgubvq:xau_L02ChKUi5aK4Pmv5hjoARwOExaYTuDAg1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require'\n    }\n  }\n];\n\nasync function testXataLite(config) {\n  // Try to query a table to test the connection\n  // Let's try the 'documents' table from the schema\n  const response = await fetch(&#96;${config.url}:main/tables/documents/query&#96;, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: {\n      'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n      'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      page: { size: 1 }, // Just get 1 record to test\n      columns: ['id', 'title'] // Basic columns\n    })\n  });\n\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    throw new Error(&#96;HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const data = await response.json();\n  \n  // Load schema from local file to get table count\n  const fs = require('fs');\n  const schemaPath = './data/schema.json';\n  let tableCount = 0;\n  \n  try {\n    const schema = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8'));\n    tableCount = schema.tables.length;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.warn('Could not read schema file, using query result only');\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    tables: Array.from({ length: tableCount }, (_, i) =\u003e ({ name: &#96;table_${i}&#96; })),\n    version: 'Xata Lite HTTP API',\n    recordCount: data.records ? data.records.length : 0\n  };\n}",

        "originalContents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n\n/**\n * Quick Connection Test Script\n * Tests both Xata Lite and Xata Postgres connections\n */\n\nconst { Client } = require('pg');\n\n// Test configurations\nconst tests = [\n  {\n    name: 'Xata Lite (HTTP API)',\n    type: 'http',\n    config: {\n      url: 'https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial',\n      apiKey: 'xau_LKJxzxjzXasEUXxjmhCBACdTCvi5Ed2v1'\n    }\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Xata Postgres (Wire Protocol)',\n    type: 'postgres',\n    config: {\n      connectionString: 'postgresql://kgubvq:xau_L02ChKUi5aK4Pmv5hjoARwOExaYTuDAg1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require'\n    }\n  }\n];\n\nasync function testXataLite(config) {\n  // Try to query a table to test the connection\n  // Let's try the 'documents' table from the schema\n  const response = await fetch(&#96;${config.url}:main/tables/documents/query&#96;, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: {\n      'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n      'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      page: { size: 1 }, // Just get 1 record to test\n      columns: ['id', 'title'] // Basic columns\n    })\n  });\n\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    throw new Error(&#96;HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const data = await response.json();\n  \n  // Load schema from local file to get table count\n  const fs = require('fs');\n  const schemaPath = './data/schema.json';\n  let tableCount = 0;\n  \n  try {\n    const schema = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8'));\n    tableCount = schema.tables.length;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.warn('Could not read schema file, using query result only');\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    tables: Array.from({ length: tableCount }, (_, i) =\u003e ({ name: &#96;table_${i}&#96; })),\n    version: 'Xata Lite HTTP API',\n    recordCount: data.records ? data.records.length : 0\n  };\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "async function getDocumentsWithAuthors(limit = 10) {\n  // HTTP API (limited join support)\n  const documents = await xata.sql&#96;\n    SELECT \n      d.*,\n      p.name as author_name,\n      p.bio as author_bio\n    FROM \"documents\" d\n    LEFT JOIN \"personnel\" p ON d.author = p.id\n    ORDER BY d.date DESC\n    LIMIT ${limit}\n  &#96;;\n  \n  return documents.records;\n}\n\n// Postgres Wire (full join capabilities)\nasync function getDocumentsWithAuthorsAdvanced(filters: DocumentFilters) {\n  const query = &#96;\n    SELECT \n      d.id,\n      d.title,\n      d.summary,\n      d.date,\n      d.processed,\n      p.name as author_name,\n      p.role as author_role,\n      p.credibility as author_credibility,\n      o.name as organization_name,\n      o.specialization as org_specialization,\n      COUNT(ud.id) as save_count\n    FROM documents d\n    LEFT JOIN personnel p ON d.author = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN organizations o ON d.organization = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN \"user-saved-documents\" ud ON d.id = ud.document\n    WHERE \n      ($1::text IS NULL OR d.title ILIKE $1)\n      AND ($2::date IS NULL OR d.date \u003e= $2)\n      AND ($3::boolean IS NULL OR d.processed = $3)\n    GROUP BY d.id, p.id, o.id\n    ORDER BY d.date DESC, save_count DESC\n    LIMIT $4\n  &#96;;\n  \n  const result = await client.query(query, [\n    filters.titleSearch ? &#96;%${filters.titleSearch}%&#96; : null,\n    filters.dateFrom || null,\n    filters.processedOnly || null,\n    filters.limit || 10\n  ]);\n  \n  return result.rows;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Many-to-Many Relationships\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Topic-Testimony relationships\nasync function linkTopicToTestimony(topicId: string, testimonyId: string) {\n  // HTTP API\n  const link = await xata.sql&#96;\n    INSERT INTO \"topics-testimonies\" (topic, testimony)\n    VALUES (${topicId}, ${testimonyId})\n    ON CONFLICT (topic, testimony) DO NOTHING\n    RETURNING *\n  &#96;;\n  \n  return link.records[0];\n}\n\n// Get topics with related testimonies count\n",

        "originalContents": "async function getDocumentsWithAuthors(limit = 10) {\n  // HTTP API (limited join support)\n  const documents = await xata.sql&#96;\n    SELECT \n      d.*,\n      p.name as author_name,\n      p.bio as author_bio\n    FROM \"documents\" d\n    LEFT JOIN \"personnel\" p ON d.author = p.id\n    ORDER BY d.date DESC\n    LIMIT ${limit}\n  &#96;;\n  \n  return documents.records;\n}\n\n// Postgres Wire (full join capabilities)\nasync function getDocumentsWithAuthorsAdvanced(filters: DocumentFilters) {\n  const query = &#96;\n    SELECT \n      d.id,\n      d.title,\n      d.summary,\n      d.date,\n      d.processed,\n      p.name as author_name,\n      p.role as author_role,\n      p.credibility as author_credibility,\n      o.name as organization_name,\n      o.specialization as org_specialization,\n      COUNT(ud.id) as save_count\n    FROM documents d\n    LEFT JOIN personnel p ON d.author = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN organizations o ON d.organization = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN \"user-saved-documents\" ud ON d.id = ud.document\n    WHERE \n      ($1::text IS NULL OR d.title ILIKE $1)\n      AND ($2::date IS NULL OR d.date \u003e= $2)\n      AND ($3::boolean IS NULL OR d.processed = $3)\n    GROUP BY d.id, p.id, o.id\n    ORDER BY d.date DESC, save_count DESC\n    LIMIT $4\n  &#96;;\n  \n  const result = await client.query(query, [\n    filters.titleSearch ? &#96;%${filters.titleSearch}%&#96; : null,\n    filters.dateFrom || null,\n    filters.processedOnly || null,\n    filters.limit || 10\n  ]);\n  \n  return result.rows;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Many-to-Many Relationships\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Topic-Testimony relationships\nasync function linkTopicToTestimony(topicId: string, testimonyId: string) {\n  // HTTP API\n  const link = await xata.sql&#96;\n    INSERT INTO \"topics-testimonies\" (topic, testimony)\n    VALUES (${topicId}, ${testimonyId})\n    ON CONFLICT (topic, testimony) DO NOTHING\n    RETURNING *\n  &#96;;\n  \n  return link.records[0];\n}\n\n// Get topics with related testimonies count\n",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n\n/**\n * Quick Connection Test Script\n * Tests both Xata Lite and Xata Postgres connections\n */\n\nconst { Client } = require('pg');\n\n// Test configurations\nconst tests = [\n  {\n    name: 'Xata Lite (HTTP API)',\n    type: 'http',\n    config: {\n      url: 'https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial',\n      apiKey: 'xau_LKJxzxjzXasEUXxjmhCBACdTCvi5Ed2v1'\n    }\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Xata Postgres (Wire Protocol)',\n    type: 'postgres',\n    config: {\n      connectionString: 'postgresql://kgubvq:xau_L02ChKUi5aK4Pmv5hjoARwOExaYTuDAg1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require'\n    }\n  }\n];\n\nasync function testXataLite(config) {\n  // Try to query a table to test the connection\n  // Let's try the 'documents' table from the schema\n  const response = await fetch(&#96;${config.url}:main/tables/documents/query&#96;, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: {\n      'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n      'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      page: { size: 1 }, // Just get 1 record to test\n      columns: ['id', 'title'] // Basic columns\n    })\n  });\n\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    throw new Error(&#96;HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const data = await response.json();\n  \n  // Load schema from local file to get table count\n  const fs = require('fs');\n  const schemaPath = './data/schema.json';\n  let tableCount = 0;\n  \n  try {\n    const schema = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8'));\n    tableCount = schema.tables.length;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.warn('Could not read schema file, using query result only');\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    tables: Array.from({ length: tableCount }, (_, i) =\u003e ({ name: &#96;table_${i}&#96; })),\n    version: 'Xata Lite HTTP API',\n    recordCount: data.records ? data.records.length : 0\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string, metadata?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e): DetectedConnection {\n    const reasons: string[] = [];\n    let confidence = 0;\n\n    // Check for Xata URL patterns\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      reasons.push('URL contains .xata.sh domain');\n      confidence += 0.8;\n\n      // Determine if it's HTTP API or Postgres wire\n      if (connectionString.startsWith('https://') || connectionString.startsWith('http://')) {\n        reasons.push('HTTPS URL indicates Xata Lite HTTP API');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_lite_http',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      } else if (connectionString.startsWith('postgres://') || connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n        reasons.push('PostgreSQL connection string with Xata domain indicates wire protocol support');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence, reasons };\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  private static detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string, metadata?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e): DetectedConnection {\n    const reasons: string[] = [];\n    let confidence = 0;\n\n    // Check for Xata URL patterns\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      reasons.push('URL contains .xata.sh domain');\n      confidence += 0.8;\n\n      // Determine if it's HTTP API or Postgres wire\n      if (connectionString.startsWith('https://') || connectionString.startsWith('http://')) {\n        reasons.push('HTTPS URL indicates Xata Lite HTTP API');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_lite_http',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      } else if (connectionString.startsWith('postgres://') || connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n        reasons.push('PostgreSQL connection string with Xata domain indicates wire protocol support');\n        return {\n          type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n          confidence: 0.95,\n          reasons,\n          suggestedMetadata: {\n            branch: metadata?.branch || 'main'\n          }\n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence, reasons };\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport class XataLiteAdapter extends BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n  private xataClient: typeof wirelessXataClient;\n  private databaseName: string;\n  private branch: string;\n  private baseUrl: string;\n  private apiKey: string;\n\n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n    \n    // For Xata Lite, the \"connectionString\" is actually the HTTP API endpoint\n    // Format: https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh/db/database\n    let endpoint = config.connectionString;\n    \n    // Ensure it's a proper HTTP URL\n    if (!endpoint.startsWith('http://') \u0026\u0026 !endpoint.startsWith('https://')) {\n      throw new Error('Xata Lite endpoint must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL');\n    }\n    \n    // Parse the endpoint to extract database name\n    const url = new URL(endpoint);\n    const pathParts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(part =\u003e part.length \u003e 0);\n    if (pathParts.length \u003c 2 || pathParts[0] !== 'db') {\n      throw new Error('Invalid Xata endpoint format. Expected: https://workspace.region.xata.sh/db/database-name');\n    }\n    \n    this.databaseName = pathParts[1];\n    this.branch = config.metadata?.branch || 'main';\n    this.baseUrl = &#96;${url.protocol}//${url.host}&#96;;\n    \n    if (!config.apiKey) {\n      throw new Error('API key is required for Xata Lite connections');\n    }\n    this.apiKey = config.apiKey;\n    \n    // Use the pre-configured wireless client\n    this.xataClient = wirelessXataClient;\n    \n    console.log('Xata Lite adapter initialized with SDK:', {\n      database: this.databaseName,\n      branch: this.branch,\n      endpoint: endpoint\n    });\n  }",

        "contents": "# Xata SQL Methods Documentation\n\n## Table of Contents\n1. [Overview](#overview)\n2. [Connection Methods](#connection-methods)\n3. [Core SQL Methods](#core-sql-methods)\n4. [CRUD Operations](#crud-operations)\n5. [Advanced Features](#advanced-features)\n6. [Performance \u0026 Optimization](#performance--optimization)\n7. [Integration Patterns](#integration-patterns)\n8. [Error Handling](#error-handling)\n9. [Best Practices](#best-practices)\n10. [Examples \u0026 Use Cases](#examples--use-cases)\n\n## Overview\n\nXata provides SQL capabilities through two distinct approaches:\n\n### 1. Xata Lite (HTTP API)\n- **Protocol**: HTTP/HTTPS REST API\n- **SQL Support**: Limited subset of SQL commands\n- **Use Case**: Simple queries, built-in search features\n- **Limitations**: No complex joins, limited transaction support\n\n### 2. Xata Postgres Wire Protocol\n- **Protocol**: PostgreSQL wire protocol\n- **SQL Support**: Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n- **Use Case**: Complex queries, advanced analytics, migrations\n- **Benefits**: Complete SQL feature set, performance monitoring\n\n## Connection Methods\n\n### HTTP API Connection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { XataApiClient } from '@xata.io/client';\n\nconst xata = new XataApiClient({\n  apiKey: 'xau_your_api_key_here',\n  databaseURL: 'https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh',\n  branch: 'main'\n});\n\n// Execute SQL via HTTP\nconst result = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE email = ${email}&#96;;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Postgres Wire Connection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Client } from 'pg';\n\nconst client = new Client({\n  connectionString: 'postgresql://user:password@workspace.region.sql.xata.sh/database:branch?sslmode=require'\n});\n\nawait client.connect();\nconst result = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1', [email]);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core SQL Methods\n\n### 1. Query Execution\n\n#### HTTP API Method\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface XataHttpSqlOptions {\n  consistency?: 'strong' | 'eventual';\n  timeout?: number;\n}\n\n// Template literal syntax (recommended)\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n  detect(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    // Detect Xata connections\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      return this.detectXata(connectionString, apiKey);\n    }\n    \n    // Detect other database types\n    return this.detectOtherDatabases(connectionString);\n  }\n  \n  private detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    if (connectionString.startsWith('https://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_lite_http',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['HTTPS URL with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          requiresApiKey: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    if (connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['PostgreSQL connection string with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          supportsSql: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence: 0, reasons: [] };\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Connection Pool Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Connection pool for Postgres Wire\n",

        ],
        "originalContents": "export class ConnectionDetector {\n  detect(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    // Detect Xata connections\n    if (connectionString.includes('.xata.sh')) {\n      return this.detectXata(connectionString, apiKey);\n    }\n    \n    // Detect other database types\n    return this.detectOtherDatabases(connectionString);\n  }\n  \n  private detectXata(connectionString: string, apiKey?: string): DetectedConnection {\n    if (connectionString.startsWith('https://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_lite_http',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['HTTPS URL with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          requiresApiKey: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    if (connectionString.startsWith('postgresql://')) {\n      return {\n        type: 'xata_postgres_wire',\n        confidence: 0.95,\n        reasons: ['PostgreSQL connection string with .xata.sh domain'],\n        suggestedMetadata: {\n          branch: 'main',\n          supportsSql: true\n        }\n      };\n    }\n    \n    return { type: 'postgres', confidence: 0, reasons: [] };\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Connection Pool Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Connection pool for Postgres Wire\n",

        "contents": "### 3. Resource Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Always clean up connections\nclass DatabaseService {\n  private client: Client;\n  \n  constructor(connectionString: string) {\n    this.client = new Client({ connectionString });\n  }\n  \n  async connect() {\n    await this.client.connect();\n  }\n  \n  async disconnect() {\n    await this.client.end();\n  }\n  \n  async query(text: string, params?: any[]) {\n    try {\n      return await this.client.query(text, params);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Query failed:', { text, params, error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Migration Guide\n\n### From HTTP API to Postgres Wire\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Before (HTTP API)\nconst users = await xata.sql&#96;SELECT * FROM \"users\" WHERE active = true&#96;;\n\n// After (Postgres Wire)\nconst users = await client.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = true');\n\n// Key differences:\n// 1. No need to quote table names in Postgres Wire\n// 2. Different parameter syntax ($1, $2 vs template literals)\n// 3. Full PostgreSQL feature set available\n// 4. Better performance monitoring and optimization tools\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Adapter Migration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Detect and migrate connections\nimport { ConnectionDetector } from './lib/adapters/connection-detector';\n\nconst detector = new ConnectionDetector();\nconst detection = detector.detect(connectionString, apiKey);\n\nif (detection.type === 'xata_lite_http') {\n  console.log('Migrating from Xata Lite to Postgres Wire...');\n  // Migration logic here\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### Common Issues\n\n1. **Connection Timeouts**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Increase timeout for long-running queries\nconst result = await xata.sql({\n  statement: 'SELECT * FROM large_table',\n  timeout: 30000 // 30 seconds\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Memory Issues**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Use streaming for large result sets (Postgres Wire)\nconst query = new QueryStream('SELECT * FROM large_table');\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Xata Support Verification \u0026 Fixes\n\n## Immediate Priority: Non Postgres Wire Enabled Support\n\n### Current Implementation Status ✅\n\nThe codebase has excellent dual support:\n\n1. **XataLiteAdapter** (&#96;xata_lite_http&#96;) - For Non Postgres Wire Enabled instances\n2. **XataPostgresAdapter** (&#96;xata_postgres_wire&#96;) - For Postgres Wire Enabled instances\n\n### Critical Issues Found 🚨\n\n1. **Missing Wireless SDK Import Path** - The import in &#96;xata-lite.ts&#96; points to a non-existent directory\n2. **Connection String Validation** - Needs better error handling\n3. **API Key Configuration** - Environment setup needs verification\n\n### Immediate Fixes Required\n\n#### 1. Fix Wireless SDK Import Path\n\nThe current import in &#96;src/lib/adapters/xata-lite.ts&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { wirelessXataClient } from '../../xata-wireless-sdk/wireless';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Issue**: This path doesn't exist. It should point to the legacy directory.\n\n#### 2. Environment Configuration\n\n**Required Environment Variables**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nXATA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here\nXATA_DATABASE_URL=https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh/db/database-name\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. Connection Type Detection\n\nThe system correctly detects connection types:\n- HTTP URLs → &#96;xata_lite_http&#96; (Non Postgres Wire)\n- PostgreSQL URLs → &#96;xata_postgres_wire&#96; (Wire Enabled)\n\n### Testing Commands\n\n1. **Test Non Postgres Wire Connection**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd apps/dbagent\n   npm run test:xata-wireless\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Test Connection Detection**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # This should detect as xata_lite_http\n   https://workspace-db.region.xata.sh/db/dbname\n   \n   # This should detect as xata_postgres_wire  \n   postgresql://user:pass@workspace-db.xata.sh:5432/dbname\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Next Steps\n\n1. **Fix wireless SDK import path** ⚠️ URGENT\n2. **Verify environment configuration**\n3. **Test Non Postgres Wire connection**\n4. **Update connection form UI** if needed\n\n### Support Matrix\n\n| Feature | Xata Lite (HTTP) | Xata Postgres Wire |\n",

        "originalContents": "# Xata Support Verification \u0026 Fixes\n\n## Immediate Priority: Non Postgres Wire Enabled Support\n\n### Current Implementation Status ✅\n\nThe codebase has excellent dual support:\n\n1. **XataLiteAdapter** (&#96;xata_lite_http&#96;) - For Non Postgres Wire Enabled instances\n2. **XataPostgresAdapter** (&#96;xata_postgres_wire&#96;) - For Postgres Wire Enabled instances\n\n### Critical Issues Found 🚨\n\n1. **Missing Wireless SDK Import Path** - The import in &#96;xata-lite.ts&#96; points to a non-existent directory\n2. **Connection String Validation** - Needs better error handling\n3. **API Key Configuration** - Environment setup needs verification\n\n### Immediate Fixes Required\n\n#### 1. Fix Wireless SDK Import Path\n\nThe current import in &#96;src/lib/adapters/xata-lite.ts&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { wirelessXataClient } from '../../xata-wireless-sdk/wireless';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Issue**: This path doesn't exist. It should point to the legacy directory.\n\n#### 2. Environment Configuration\n\n**Required Environment Variables**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nXATA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here\nXATA_DATABASE_URL=https://workspace-database.region.xata.sh/db/database-name\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. Connection Type Detection\n\nThe system correctly detects connection types:\n- HTTP URLs → &#96;xata_lite_http&#96; (Non Postgres Wire)\n- PostgreSQL URLs → &#96;xata_postgres_wire&#96; (Wire Enabled)\n\n### Testing Commands\n\n1. **Test Non Postgres Wire Connection**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd apps/dbagent\n   npm run test:xata-wireless\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Test Connection Detection**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # This should detect as xata_lite_http\n   https://workspace-db.region.xata.sh/db/dbname\n   \n   # This should detect as xata_postgres_wire  \n   postgresql://user:pass@workspace-db.xata.sh:5432/dbname\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Next Steps\n\n1. **Fix wireless SDK import path** ⚠️ URGENT\n2. **Verify environment configuration**\n3. **Test Non Postgres Wire connection**\n4. **Update connection form UI** if needed\n\n### Support Matrix\n\n| Feature | Xata Lite (HTTP) | Xata Postgres Wire |\n",

        "originalContents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n\n/**\n * Data Migration Script: Xata Lite → Xata Postgres\n * \n * This script copies data from your Xata Lite instance (HTTP API)\n * to your new Xata Postgres instance (Wire Protocol)\n */\n\nconst { Client } = require('pg');\n\n// Configuration\nconst XATA_LITE_CONFIG = {\n  url: 'https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial',\n  apiKey: 'xau_LKJxzxjzXasEUXxjmhCBACdTCvi5Ed2v1',\n  branch: 'main'\n};\n\nconst XATA_POSTGRES_CONFIG = {\n  connectionString: 'postgresql://kgubvq:xau_L02ChKUi5aK4Pmv5hjoARwOExaYTuDAg1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require'\n};\n\nclass XataLiteClient {\n  constructor(config) {\n    this.baseUrl = config.url;\n    this.apiKey = config.apiKey;\n    this.branch = config.branch;\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class XataLiteAdapter extends BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n  private baseUrl: string;\n  private apiKey: string;\n  private branch: string;\n  \n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n    this.parseXataConfig(config);\n  }\n  \n  async executeQuery(query: string, params: any[] = []): Promise\u003cQueryResult\u003e {\n    // Xata Lite doesn't support arbitrary SQL\n    throw new Error('Raw SQL queries not supported in Xata Lite');\n  }\n  \n  // Xata-specific methods\n  async getRecords(tableName: string, options: XataQueryOptions): Promise\u003cXataRecordsResult\u003e {\n    const response = await this.makeRequest('POST', &#96;/tables/${tableName}/query&#96;, options);\n    return await response.json();\n  }\n  \n  async searchRecords(tableName: string, query: string, options: XataSearchOptions): Promise\u003cXataSearchResult\u003e {\n    const response = await this.makeRequest('POST', &#96;/tables/${tableName}/search&#96;, {\n      query,\n      ...options\n    });\n    return await response.json();\n  }\n}\n\n// Postgres Wire Adapter\nclass XataPostgresAdapter extends PostgreSQLAdapter {\n  constructor(config: ConnectionConfig) {\n    super(config);\n  }\n  \n  async executeQuery(query: string, params: any[] = []): Promise\u003cQueryResult\u003e {\n    // Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n    return await super.executeQuery(query, params);\n  }\n  \n  // Xata-enhanced methods\n  async getXataMetadata(): Promise\u003cXataMetadata\u003e {\n    const result = await this.executeQuery(&#96;\n      SELECT \n        table_name,\n        column_name,\n        data_type\n      FROM information_schema.columns \n      WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n      ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position\n    &#96;);\n    \n    return this.parseXataMetadata(result.rows);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Adapter Factory Pattern\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// From: apps/dbagent/src/lib/adapters/base.ts\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Test Xata Non Wire connection\n */\nexport async function testXataNonWireConnection(config: XataConnection): Promise\u003c{\n  success: boolean;\n  error?: string;\n  details?: any;\n}\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Test basic connection by getting first record from events table\n    const result = await wirelessXataClient.db.events.getFirst();\n    \n    return {\n      success: true,\n      details: {\n        connected: true,\n        testQuery: 'events.getFirst()',\n        hasData: !!result\n      }\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown connection error',\n      details: {\n        connected: false,\n        endpoint: config.endpoint,\n        database: config.database\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# 🎯 Demo Queries: Xata Lite vs Xata Postgres\n\n## 🔄 **Connection Switching Demo**\n\n### **Step 1: Start with Xata Lite**\nSwitch to &#96;xata-lite-original&#96; connection and ask:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"What database am I connected to?\"\n\"What tables do you see?\"\n\"What's the database structure?\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Expected Response:**\n- ✅ Identifies as Xata Lite (HTTP API)\n- ✅ Lists tables via REST API\n- ❌ Cannot run raw SQL\n\n### **Step 2: Switch to Xata Postgres**\nSwitch to &#96;xata-postgres-wire&#96; connection and ask:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"What database am I connected to?\"\n\"What tables do you see?\"\n\"Run: SELECT version();\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Expected Response:**\n- ✅ Identifies as PostgreSQL (Xata wire protocol)\n- ✅ Lists tables via SQL queries\n- ✅ Shows PostgreSQL version\n\n## 📊 **Capability Comparison Demos**\n\n### **Database Introspection**\n\n**Xata Lite (Limited):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"Show me the schema of the [table_name] table\"\n\"How many records are in each table?\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Xata Postgres (Full SQL):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n\"DESCRIBE table_name;\"\n\"SELECT table_name, table_rows, data_length FROM information_schema.tables;\"\n\"SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'your_table';\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### **Performance Monitoring**\n\n**Xata Lite (Basic):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"What's the database size?\"\n\"Show me table statistics\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Xata Postgres (Advanced):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n\"SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle';\"\n\"EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM your_table LIMIT 10;\"\n\"SELECT schemaname, tablename, seq_scan, idx_scan FROM pg_stat_user_tables;\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### **Search Capabilities**\n\n**Xata Lite (Built-in Search):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"Search for records containing 'alien'\"\n\"Find documents with 'UFO' in the title\"\n\"Show me records similar to [some text]\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Xata Postgres (SQL + Extensions):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n\"SELECT * FROM documents WHERE title ILIKE '%UFO%';\"\n\"SELECT *, ts_rank(search_vector, query) FROM documents, plainto_tsquery('alien') query WHERE search_vector @@ query;\"\n",

        "contents": "# 🚀 Multi-Database Xata Agent Setup Guide\n\n## 📋 **Step 1: Deploy the Agent**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-database-agent\ndocker-compose up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWait for containers to start, then visit: **http://localhost:8080**\n\n## 🔗 **Step 2: Add Your Database Connections**\n\n### **Connection 1: Xata Lite (HTTP API)**\n1. Go to **Add New Connection**\n2. Fill in:\n   - **Name**: &#96;xata-lite-original&#96;\n   - **Connection String**: &#96;https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial&#96;\n   - **API Key**: &#96;xau_LKJxzxjzXasEUXxjmhCBACdTCvi5Ed2v1&#96;\n3. Click **Test Connection** → Should show success\n4. Click **Save**\n\n### **Connection 2: Xata Postgres Wire**\n1. Go to **Add New Connection** again\n2. Fill in:\n   - **Name**: &#96;xata-postgres-wire&#96;\n   - **Connection String**: &#96;postgresql://kgubvq:xau_L02ChKUi5aK4Pmv5hjoARwOExaYTuDAg1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require&#96;\n3. Click **Test Connection** → Should show success with Postgres version\n4. Click **Save**\n\n## 🎯 **Step 3: Verify Both Connections**\n\nYou should now see:\n- ✅ **xata-lite-original** (HTTP API)\n- ✅ **xata-postgres-wire** (Postgres Wire)\n\n## 🔄 **Step 4: Switch Between Databases**\n\n### **In Chat Interface:**\n1. Go to **New Chat**\n2. Look for **Connection Selector** dropdown\n3. Switch between your two Xata instances\n4. Ask questions like:\n   - \"What tables do you see?\"\n   - \"Show me the database schema\"\n   - \"What's the size of this database?\"\n\n### **Different Capabilities:**\n\n**Xata Lite (HTTP):**\n- ✅ View tables and records\n- ✅ Full-text search\n- ✅ Vector search (if configured)\n- ❌ Raw SQL queries\n- ❌ Performance monitoring\n\n**Xata Postgres Wire:**\n- ✅ Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n- ✅ Raw SQL queries\n- ✅ Performance monitoring\n- ✅ All standard Postgres features\n- ✅ Schema introspection\n\n## 🧪 **Step 5: Test Queries**\n\n### **For Xata Lite:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"Search for records containing 'alien'\"\n",

        "originalContents": "# 🚀 Multi-Database Xata Agent Setup Guide\n\n## 📋 **Step 1: Deploy the Agent**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-database-agent\ndocker-compose up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWait for containers to start, then visit: **http://localhost:8080**\n\n## 🔗 **Step 2: Add Your Database Connections**\n\n### **Connection 1: Xata Lite (HTTP API)**\n1. Go to **Add New Connection**\n2. Fill in:\n   - **Name**: &#96;xata-lite-original&#96;\n   - **Connection String**: &#96;https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial&#96;\n   - **API Key**: &#96;xau_LKJxzxjzXasEUXxjmhCBACdTCvi5Ed2v1&#96;\n3. Click **Test Connection** → Should show success\n4. Click **Save**\n\n### **Connection 2: Xata Postgres Wire**\n1. Go to **Add New Connection** again\n2. Fill in:\n   - **Name**: &#96;xata-postgres-wire&#96;\n   - **Connection String**: &#96;postgresql://kgubvq:xau_L02ChKUi5aK4Pmv5hjoARwOExaYTuDAg1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require&#96;\n3. Click **Test Connection** → Should show success with Postgres version\n4. Click **Save**\n\n## 🎯 **Step 3: Verify Both Connections**\n\nYou should now see:\n- ✅ **xata-lite-original** (HTTP API)\n- ✅ **xata-postgres-wire** (Postgres Wire)\n\n## 🔄 **Step 4: Switch Between Databases**\n\n### **In Chat Interface:**\n1. Go to **New Chat**\n2. Look for **Connection Selector** dropdown\n3. Switch between your two Xata instances\n4. Ask questions like:\n   - \"What tables do you see?\"\n   - \"Show me the database schema\"\n   - \"What's the size of this database?\"\n\n### **Different Capabilities:**\n\n**Xata Lite (HTTP):**\n- ✅ View tables and records\n- ✅ Full-text search\n- ✅ Vector search (if configured)\n- ❌ Raw SQL queries\n- ❌ Performance monitoring\n\n**Xata Postgres Wire:**\n- ✅ Full PostgreSQL compatibility\n- ✅ Raw SQL queries\n- ✅ Performance monitoring\n- ✅ All standard Postgres features\n- ✅ Schema introspection\n\n## 🧪 **Step 5: Test Queries**\n\n### **For Xata Lite:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"Search for records containing 'alien'\"\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class DatabaseAdapterFactory {\n  private static adapters = new Map\u003cstring, BaseDatabaseAdapter\u003e();\n  \n  static create(config: ConnectionConfig): BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n    const key = this.generateAdapterKey(config);\n    \n    if (this.adapters.has(key)) {\n      return this.adapters.get(key)!;\n    }\n    \n    const adapter = this.createAdapter(config);\n    this.adapters.set(key, adapter);\n    return adapter;\n  }\n  \n  private static createAdapter(config: ConnectionConfig): BaseDatabaseAdapter {\n    switch (config.type) {\n      case 'xata_lite_http':\n        return new XataLiteAdapter(config);\n      case 'xata_postgres_wire':\n        return new XataPostgresAdapter(config);\n      default:\n        throw new Error(&#96;Unsupported adapter type: ${config.type}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  static async cleanup(): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    const disconnectPromises = Array.from(this.adapters.values())\n      .map(adapter =\u003e adapter.disconnect().catch(console.error));\n    \n    await Promise.all(disconnectPromises);\n    this.adapters.clear();\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Connection Management\n\n### Connection Detection \u0026 Auto-Configuration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// From: apps/dbagent/src/lib/adapters/connection-detector.ts\n",

Based on the README, here's how to run the Xata Agent:

## 🚀 **Development Setup (Recommended)**

### 1. **Prerequisites**
```bash
# Install Node Version Manager
curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.0/install.sh | bash

# Use the correct Node version
nvm use

# Install pnpm if you don't have it
npm install -g pnpm@^10
```

### 2. **Install Dependencies**
```bash
cd /Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-database-agent/apps/dbagent
pnpm install
```

### 3. **Start Database**
```bash
# Start PostgreSQL via Docker
docker compose up postgres
```

### 4. **Environment Setup**
```bash
# Copy and edit environment file
cp .env.example .env.local
# Edit with your LLM credentials (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
vim .env.local
```

### 5. **Initialize Database**
```bash
pnpm run db:migrate
```

### 6. **Run the Application**
```bash
# Start the main app
pnpm run dev
```

### 7. **Start Scheduler (Optional)**
In a separate terminal:
```bash
# Only needed if you want scheduled tasks
pnpm run dev-scheduler
```

---

## 🐳 **Alternative: Docker Compose (Easier)**

If you prefer Docker:

```bash
# Copy environment file
cp .env.example .env.local
# Edit with your credentials
vim .env.local

# Run everything with Docker
docker compose up
```

---

## 🎯 **What You'll Get**

- **Main App**: Usually runs on `http://localhost:3000`
- **Database**: PostgreSQL running in Docker
- **Scheduler**: Background task processing
- **Full Xata Support**: Both Postgres Wire and Non-Postgres Wire modes

Which approach would you like to use? The Docker approach is simpler if you want everything to "just work".
